charts.title: U.S. federal marijuana arrests, 2007–2023
charts.source: NORML analysis of FBI UCR / Crime Data Explorer data, 2024-09-25
charts.caption: Floor not ceiling: 17% of agencies failed to report in 2022. The 2021 FBI methodology change means pre-2021 and post-2021 data is not directly comparable.

charts.title: Maine retail price vs national benchmarks, June 2026
charts.source: Headset June 2026 retail POS data (12-market panel); OCP 2025 Annual Report; Cannabis Promotions 2025 state table
charts.caption: Maine's OCP-weighted price ($6.62) is 26% below the $8.94 national single-gram average and 83% above the $3.62 national equivalized average — the gap reflects Maine's heavier weighting toward bulk-gram sales. Wholesale spot intentionally omitted; re-pulled quarterly per the national-context matrix §8.3.

charts.title: Federal cannabis regulatory status, three tiers (July 2026)
charts.source: DEA marijuana rescheduling page; 91 FR doc 2026-08176; 2018 Farm Bill §10113; 2026 Appropriations §781; CRS IF13136

tiers.label: Schedule III
tiers.covers: FDA-approved marijuana products AND state-licensed medical cannabis (incl. Maine MMCP)

tiers.label: Schedule I
tiers.covers: Adult-use (recreational) cannabis — all 24 legal states including Maine AUP

tiers.label: Pending federal change
tiers.status: Nov 12, 2026 (contested by H.R. 7024 / H.R. 7010 / Senate delay bills)
tiers.covers: Hemp / CBD / delta-8 THC products — switching to total-THC standard + 0.4 mg/container cap

charts.caption: The DEA ALJ hearing on the broader Schedule I → III rescheduling concluded Jul 15, 2026; post-hearing briefs due Aug 17, 2026; ALJ has no deadline; DEA Administrator final rule has no deadline.

charts.title: Cumulative federal cannabis tax burden since 2018
charts.source: Whitney Economics federal-tax-impact brief, 2026-04-09 (republished verbatim by Yahoo Finance, Cannabis Law Report, Cannabis Business Times, July 2026)

data.label: Baseline federal tax (would have applied absent 280E)

charts.caption: Cumulative $27B in federal cannabis tax since 2018; $15B is the 280E excess that cannabis operators cannot deduct. 2025 alone added $2.24B in excess 280E. The IRS Statistics of Income division does not publish a 280E-specific line; Whitney is the de facto citation standard.

charts.title: Maine vs comparable legal states — adult-use tax rate
charts.source: NCSL state-taxation tracker; state Cannabis Control Commissions; Maine Morning Star 2025-12-31 (P.L. 2025 ch. 388)
charts.caption: Maine's 14.0% adult-use retail + excise rate (post-Jan 1, 2026) sits in the upper tier for adult-use legal states. CO and CA retain higher combined rates; MA remains the lower-tax peer. Tax-rate, not total per-gram price, is what differs most across these eight states.
